pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:1.2: tena kho pana samayena rañño pasenadissa kosalassa uyyāne cittāgāre paṭibhānacittaṃ kataṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:1.6: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo cittāgāraṃ dassanāya gacchissanti seyyathāpi gihiniyo kāmabhoginiyoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:1.7: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:1.8: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:1.9: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo cittāgāraṃ dassanāya gacchissantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:1.10: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo cittāgāraṃ dassanāya gacchantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:1.13: hi nāma bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo cittāgāraṃ dassanāya gacchissanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:1.15: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:1.16.1: yā pana bhikkhunī rājāgāraṃ vā cittāgāraṃ vā ārāmaṃ vā uyyānaṃ vā pokkharaṇiṃ vā dassanāya gaccheyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:2.1.6: yattha katthaci rañño kīḷituṃ ramituṃ kataṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:2.1.8: yattha katthaci manussānaṃ kīḷituṃ ramituṃ kataṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:2.1.10: yattha katthaci manussānaṃ kīḷituṃ ramituṃ kato hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:2.1.12: yattha katthaci manussānaṃ kīḷituṃ ramituṃ kataṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:2.1.14: yattha katthaci manussānaṃ kīḷituṃ ramituṃ katā hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc41:2.1.17: dassanupacāraṃ vijahitvā punappunaṃ passati āpatti pācittiyassa.
